subject: Approval: redeploy headcount to ML infra and reset comp band for backfill
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Headcount redeploy + comp band reset for ML infra backfill

Morning team —

Quick summary: an IC3 engineer in ML Infra (REQ-2489) resigned last week; hiring freeze lift allowed a backfill but infra lead is proposing we *redeploy* the open headcount to a higher priority ML systems role (same team) and consider resetting the comp band to IC4 midpoint because of market and retention risk.

Ask: can we get sign-off to both repurpose the slot (internal transfer / redeploy) and approve a one-time comp-band uplift for a targeted external hire or high-performing internal transferee? I attached a short comp-band proposal and the candidate packet from our recruiter (Cory).

Key constraints:
- Budget owner: Laura — will this fit within Q3 hiring budget if we pay to IC4 midpoint?
- HR comp sign-off: Neha — will we need exec compensation approval or can you greenlight band reset for this requisition?
- Ops: Markus — any objections to reassigning the slot to ML Systems (same cost center)?

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura confirm budget availability by EOD Monday (6/29).
2) Neha advise if formal comp exception needed.
3) If yes to both, we instruct recruiting to prioritize Cory's candidate pack and start offer prep.

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, GTM Operations (acting head of Talent Ops)
Redwood Inference
attachments: comp-band-proposal.xlsx; candidate-pack-CoryPark-20260628.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount redeploy + comp band reset for ML infra backfill

Sofia — thanks for the note and attachments. Short answer: probably yes, but need to confirm a couple of things.

Notes after quick review:
- Q3 hiring budget has ~1.2 FTE cushion in infra/product eng, so we can absorb the uplift to IC4 midpoint for one role provided we don't also run multiple contractor conversions this quarter.
- Please confirm cost-center for the reallocated slot (if it remains in ML Infra vs. ML Systems) — that impacts budget tracking.
- Recommend we set the offer structure to include a smaller initial uplift (IC4 midpoint - 5%) + 6-mo review for performance-based bump to midpoint. That keeps near-term spend down.

I can sign off on the redeploy if Neha confirms no exec-level compensation exception required and Markus confirms team alignment. I’ll mark provisional approval now — final after HR confirmation.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount redeploy + comp band reset for ML infra backfill

Laura / Sofia —

I reviewed the proposed comp-band-proposal.xlsx. HR comments:
- If we are promoting the job scope materially (IC3 -> IC4 responsibilities) then the band reset can be treated as a role re-leveling, not an exception. In that case, executive compensation committee approval is not required; HR can approve within policy.
- If the headcount is being reused but the scope remains IC3 and we just want to pay IC4 market rate to win a candidate, that *is* an exception and will need exec review (note: turnaround 48-72 hours).

Recommendation: Document the updated scope (bullet list) and flag as re-level if at least 60% of duties align to IC4 expectations. HR will approve re-levels. I can sign off on a re-level today if you attach the revised JD.

Also — include the proposed 6-mo review language in the offer to make it clear.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Headcount redeploy + comp band reset for ML infra backfill

All —

Confirmed: ML Systems will take the headcount (same cost center 4312). I worked with the team leads; the open scope will be shifted to focus on latency-critical KV-cache and model serving reliability — this is a clear IC4-level lift. I attached a one-paragraph scope update to the req. No objections operationally.

On candidate: Cory has one external candidate with strong infra + compiler experience and an internal candidate (Ravi Shah from NovusAI partner program) who is open to joining as a transfer. If we can do a re-level HR sign-off, I prefer to prioritize internal transfer (faster ramp).

Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Engineering, Inference Runtime
